LOW_IronThrone_Prisoners_Gnome
Phoenix Lubbins is a rock gnome member of the Church of Gond, held hostage at the Iron Throne by  Enver Gortash.

Involvement

If the party enter the Iron Throne,  Enver Gortash remotely triggers explosions which soon collapse the building. Phoenix Lubbins is trapped in the southern-most of the two western cells, alongside  Featherweight Falson and  Hastar Biggs. If freed, she dashes towards the Submersible to escape.

Combat

Attacks and actions

The only action Phoenix uses on any turn is  Dash, with the help of the  Glimpse of Freedom condition which is applied when the cage is opened.

 Dash ()

Cover more distance this turn: double your Movement Speed.

 Range: Self

Notable loot

  • A Plea to Gortash
  • Scale Mail

Explorer only

  • Phoenix Lubbins has 50% more HP and cannot be pushed or shoved.
